title: Admin looks up the predictive maintenance deal by title
userProblem: I need the current stage and value of the predictive maintenance rollout deal for Acme. Can you pull it up?

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches deals by title, finds dls_001 (Predictive maintenance rollout), and answers with its stage (negotiation) and value (€480,000).

assertions.description: Agent must look the deal up rather than answer from memory.
Search must be scoped to deals.
A lookup must not mutate data.

rationale: Baseline green scenario for deal lookup by title alias. Verifies read path for the admin persona.
